description: Render a QR code with the editor's style options: colors or gradients (linear, radial), dot and eye shapes, eye and dot colors, a built-in frame with its text or a custom frame spec, a border template, a logo icon or your own uploaded logo (logoFileId, needs an API key), or a community item. Pass design_qr's qrdxStyle as style to render the same design again at another size. Returns a PNG image and public image URLs (SVG and PNG for embedding in Markdown or HTML, plus a vector EPS for print); set include_svg to also get the SVG markup. No scan check: use design_qr for that.

body.description: Shape of the data modules (default square)

dot.description: Shape of the dot inside each corner eye (default square)

dotColor.description: Color of the dot inside each corner eye (defaults to fg)

eye.description: Shape of the corner eye frames (default square)

eyeColor.description: Color of the three corner eyes (defaults to fg)

frameText.description: The frame's label, up to 24 characters

include_svg.description: Also return the SVG markup as text, e.g. to save an .svg file. It is often 50-150 KB, so only request it when needed.

item.description: A community theme or frame by id (search_community), such as frame:wifi-card; style and the flat options win over it

level.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25% (default), H 30%

logoFileId.description: Your own uploaded logo (PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB) by file id; needs the workspace's API key on this connection. The code then has no public image URL.

margin.description: Quiet zone around the code, in modules (default 4)

style.description: The editor's whole style (the qrdxStyle design_qr returns, or a community item's style): gradients, frames including custom frame specs, border templates, eye and dot colors, logoIcon, logoFileId. The flat options above win over it.

name: generate_qr_code
title: Generate QR code
